article.headline: Daniel Freitag scores 21 to help Oregon State fend off Eastern Washington 94-84
article.description: — Daniel Freitag scored 21 points and Oregon State beat Eastern Washington 94-84 on Monday night.
article.linkText: Daniel Freitag scores 21 to help Oregon State fend off Eastern Washington 94-84

event.description: Eastern Washington Eagles @ Oregon State Beavers

keywords: Eastern Washington Eagles @ Oregon State Beavers
article.story: CORVALLIS, Ore. -- — Daniel Freitag scored 21 points and Oregon State beat Eastern Washington 94-84 on Monday night. Freitag also had five assists for the Beavers (3-0). Legend Smiley shot 6 for 11, including 5 for 9 from beyond the arc to add 17 points. Josiah Lake had 15 points and shot 4 of 7 from the field, including 2 for 4 from 3-point range, and went 5 for 5 from the foul line. Emmett Marquardt led the way for the Eagles (0-3) with 18 points. Jamil Miller pitched in with 11 points and seven rebounds, while Cole Scherer scored 10 points. Oregon State took the lead with 13:08 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Smiley had 14 points in the first half for a 49-37 advantage at the break. Oregon State used a 10-0 run in the second half to build an 18-point lead at 81-63 with 6:41 left. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
